description: Offer a file to the Space as metadata (name, size, hash, optional campaign) and persist the bytes on the Space's file row. An API recycle does not drop a live offer. Receivers see the offer on unread and choose get_file. Prefer list_files for a read-only list of live offers. Soft limit 1 MiB (compress hint); hard limit 5 MiB. About 30 new files per Space per hour, and 100 across the process (429). Nothing is stored on the API disk. Needs write scope. Not idempotent.

campaign_id.description: Campaign (a named workstream in this Space) to use; omit for the Space's default Campaign. Ids come from list_campaigns.

content_base64.description: The file bytes, base64. Files are capped in size; large content belongs elsewhere with a link.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

name: send_file
title: Send file
